keyAdjustments: F18: removed 'Warehouse Mobile App'. It is a container with components (Scan Capture, Offline Scan Queue, Proof of Delivery Capture); the pack-task scan screen is Scan Capture, which the key already links.

F05: removed 'File Store'. Keeping fax attachments in the existing bucket is ordinary use of shared storage (no new store, no Object Lock or retention work: §6 locks only evidence prefixes). Mailbox Intake owns that write.

F05: added 'Operations Database' (convinced by the work). §8 gives ORDER_DRAFT its own '90 days after decision' retention, unlike the 5-year order tables. That retention is database-specific work under the agreed rule. The old key treated the database as neutral.

Kept F07 'Pack Audit Ledger'. §6 'one schema per module' means Billing cannot read PACK_RECORD tables directly. Pack Audit Ledger must expose accepted packed quantity per order line, and the existing Stage Engine read (accepted records for stage moves) has a different shape. So the feature does work in Pack Audit Ledger, not just uses it.

Kept F07 'Scheduled Checks'. QuickBooks token refresh is a named §6 responsibility, and F07 brings in the QuickBooks push/pull that depends on it. The feature builds it; this is not shared plumbing it merely uses.
Kept 'Office Web App' wherever it was linked. It is a container with no components, and each feature adds its own screens rather than changing the app shell.

wrong.reason: Ordinary use of the existing object store. No new store, no retention or locking work for fax attachments.

missing.reason: Billing needs accepted packed quantity per line (BR-002). With one schema per module, Pack Audit Ledger must expose that read. C's Billing why depends on it but does not link it.

patterns: C already follows the new conventions. It links components and not their containers (no Warehouse Mobile App on F18), and it links the database only once, for a real retention rule (Order Draft 90 days). That link corrected the key.

C's one miss is work hidden behind a dependency. On F07 it treats Pack Audit Ledger as something Billing only reads. Under one schema per module, the accepted-quantity read is new work inside Pack Audit Ledger.
C's one wrong link is shared storage merely used. File Store on F05 copies the C4 edge 'worker -> files', but storing fax attachments needs no storage-specific work.
C's whys match each component's §6 Responsibility and stay inside their feature. No whys borrow scope from other features.
